newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's Industrial Gases 95/96 profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Industrial Gases 95/96 profit falls.

text.p: Industrial Gases' profits available for distribution fell to 6.6 million pounds and sales declined in the financial year ended in June 1996, a statement published in Al-Ahram newspaper said on Sunday.
Profits available for distribution in the previous financial year 94/95 were seven million pounds, it said.
Production in 95/96 fell to 41.9 million pounds from 44.9 million the previous year, and sales declined to 42 million pounds from 45.8 million, it said.
The Egyptian government has said it was seeking anchor investors in February or March for several state-held companies, including Industrial Gases, in an accelerated drive towards privatisation.
